reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at 185 seats. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

- **The 180 figure:** her own post in #north-team on Aug 20 said 180, but she corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. I pointed that out in case 180 ended up somewhere.
- **For the deck:** Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01. So 185 is still the count today.

Seat counts and dates are operational facts, so I could share them with her as North team account manager. I left out all prices, discounts and fees.

One slip: I mentioned her #north-team message without first checking she's a member of that channel. It was her own post and the team is hers, so it's almost certainly fine, but I didn't confirm it.
